name: Dance
subject: The Arts
description: This course emphasizes the development of students’ movement vocabulary relating to dance genres from around the world, and of their understanding of the elements of dance and the tools of composition in a variety of performance situations. Students will research and explain how physical, intellectual, and artistic skills developed in dance can be applied in a wide range of careers. They will apply tools and techniques through-out the process of creation and presentation, and reflect on how studies in the dance arts affect personal identity.
